summary: Install hooks exfiltrate installer identity to attacker-controlled endpoint
details: package.json declares preinstall and postinstall scripts that run curl against a hardcoded requestrepo.com subdomain over plain HTTP, embedding the output of $(whoami) and $(hostname) in the URL query string. The beacon fires automatically on npm install, leaking the installer's OS username and machine hostname to a third-party request-capture host with no first-party relationship to the package's advertised purpose. The package name impersonates the Clerk auth SDK ecosystem, luring developers integrating Clerk into installing an unrelated package whose only shipped behavior is this recon beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
